method.signal: rank_emerging_growth.emerging_growth_score at month-end (Python port of src/lib/researchScreens.js::rankEmergingGrowth) over rank_week's point-in-time rows
method.execution: next SPY trading-day close after signal
method.selection: top 20 qualifiers (strict screen -- unfilled slots sit in cash, not backfilled)
method.weighting: emerging-growth rank score divided by sum of selected rank scores
method.prices: Yahoo adjusted close (split and dividend adjusted)

bias_disclosures.reason: advisor_universe.json is a current candidate list, not dated Russell 1000 membership
